title: Puppy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- background-free, cute puppy on Doot's LED screen -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#d98848'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#f6c99a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='24' fill='#e09555'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f6c99a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='40' rx='9' ry='16' fill='#b56a32' transform='rotate(-20 27 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='40' rx='9' ry='16' fill='#b56a32' transform='rotate(20 73 40)'/>
  <!-- ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='41' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#e8a06b' transform='rotate(-20 28 41)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='41' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#e8a06b' transform='rotate(20 72 41)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='41.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='41.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='51' r='1.2' fill='#9f8fc0'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 55 Q46 61 42 58' stroke='#8a5a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 55 Q54 61 58 58' stroke='#8a5a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#f26d8d'/>
  <path d='M50 59 L50 66' stroke='#c9486a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f79aa8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#f79aa8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='92' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f6c99a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='92' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f6c99a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 74 Q86 68 84 58' stroke='#d98848' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='56' r='4' fill='#f6c99a'/>
</svg>
